summary: Created adrs/0001-full-test-coverage/README.md — a comprehensive ADR documenting: the 3 production breakages that motivated it (wrong column names, enum value typos, import path errors); full inventory of the codebase (16 exported query functions, 23 routes, 14 templates, 91 existing tests across 4 files); four-layer test architecture with per-function/route/template coverage targets; gap analysis identifying missing coverage (get_task + retry_task queries, all 11 API routes, base/index templates, integration tests); phased implementation plan; and full test coverage matrix with success criteria.
